children: Flotek Industries closed a new senior secured term loan, drawing $75 million at signing with access to up to $45 million in delayed draw capacity to support capex, working capital and general purposes. The financing, priced at Term SOFR (2.50% floor) plus 6.50% and maturing in 2031, refinanced the outstanding PWRTEK Note, which was repaid and terminated with liens released. Flotek also executed an Intercreditor Agreement establishing lien priorities between its ABL and term loan facilities, and extended its ABL agreement with Amerisource to October 31, 2027, preserving liquidity alongside the new capital structure.
